infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Radius uses the camera to scan business cards and QR codes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Radius uses the microphone to record voice notes for new contacts.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Radius can import contacts from your address book.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Radius needs photo access to scan business cards from your library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Radius to use the camera to scan business cards.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Radius to access your contacts.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Radius to access your photos.
